title: NotchKit extension manifest
description: Canonical manifest for a NotchKit extension. Mirrors the Codable shape of NotchExtensionSDK.ExtensionMetadata. This file describes metadata only; it never describes or carries executable UI.

id.description: Stable reverse-DNS ExtensionIdentity, at least three components.

apiVersion.description: The NotchExtensionSDK API version the extension was built against.

supportedHostVersions.description: Inclusive-minimum/exclusive-maximum host version range, e.g. '>=1.0.0' or '>=1.0.0 <3.0.0'.

capabilities.description: Declared capabilities. Each must correspond to at least one entry point of the matching kind.

artifactKind.description: How the artifact is delivered and executed. Only 'compiled-in' is supported by the host today.

entryPoints.description: Declared attachment points. Ids must be unique across the extension and match contributed destination/contribution ids at runtime.

sceneName.description: Reserved for future out-of-process UI. Must be absent for compiled-in extensions.
